answer: Temporal diversity at the whisper layer: each identity must submit across randomized 30s windows, so a farm needs sustained parallel presence, not one burst. A wharf-level lock ties reward to distinct-window history; spoofing 100 identities costs 100×$12 VPS plus 500 CPU-hours held 72h. The tundra of idle time kills burst farming—returns go negative past ~10 sockpuppets. Works because time itself can't be bought in bulk.
